userStories.title: Tool-schema truth pass (5 fixes + the walker guard)
userStories.description: Fix the five verified schema/handler mismatches (anchors RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-27 on current main: actions_reports.py:99 still over-requires; all either-of error copies unchanged — re-verify again at build time): (1) actions_reports.py (~:99) platform_submit_report required[] shrinks to ['title','content'] — the handler defaults report_type='standup' and status='ok' (handlers_reports.py ~:18-24); removing from required is backward-compatible. (2) actions_assignments.py (~:41) platform_assign_tool_to_agent: the agent identifier (agent_id|agent_name either-of, enforced at handlers_assignments.py ~:19-20) must be stated in the description with the exact error copy. (3) Same either-of documentation for platform_assign_skill_to_agent, platform_assign_plugin_to_agent (actions_assignments.py ~:72,110) and platform_configure_agent_heartbeat (actions_agents.py ~:322). (4) platform_install_plugin / platform_install_skill (actions_marketplace.py ~:222,254): document the id|slug either-of their handlers enforce (handlers_marketplace.py ~:355,495). (5) Do NOT add 'source' to platform_create_mission's schema — the special-casing is a W2 deletion target; leave it. THEN add the recurrence guard: a walker test iterating every registered platform tool asserting (a) no field with a handler default sits in required[], (b) every field a handler hard-fails on is either in required[] or covered by an either-of note in the description. Encode the either-of convention the walker recognizes (e.g. the literal 'Provide X or Y' phrasing already used by handlers).

userStories.title: Dev reset — re-runnable onboarding (single-account test loop)
userStories.description: PRD W1·S10 (decision D9). Make onboarding re-runnable in ONE workspace so the operator tests with a single alias account instead of provisioning/deleting workspaces per attempt. (1) reset_onboarding(db, workspace, *, reset_trial=False, wipe_built=False, wipe_credentials=False) in orchestrator/services/onboarding_state.py: rewrite workspaces.onboarding to the initial doc via FULL JSONB reassignment (PRD-220-safe; match _write_trial's jsonb_set/whole-value style). This function is the ONLY sanctioned backward writer — do NOT loosen advance_onboarding_stage's monotonic/terminal validator. Preserve the trial object unless reset_trial; always stamp resets (incrementing int) + last_reset_at inside the doc. (2) reset_trial=True: strip the trial key, then re-grant via grant_trial_at_provisioning(db, workspace_id, owner_id=...) — REUSE, never a second grant implementation; a kill-switch/daily-cap decline is a reported pause in the response, not an error. (3) wipe_built=True: workspace-scoped deletion of what onboarding built — non-system agents (is_system_agent=False AND required_role != 'onboarding') + dependent rows, missions + orchestration tasks, agent reports/Deliverables, intake documents + workspace graphs, and the workspace's S3 document prefix — by REUSING services/workspace_purge.py machinery (_discover_scoped_tables / FK-safe ordering / _purge_s3_prefix) parameterized to spare survivors; NEVER a hand-maintained duplicate table list (two lists drift). The purge service's soft-deleted precondition, its workspace-row DELETE, its users DELETE, and its Clerk-user deletion must NOT apply on this path. (4) wipe_credentials=True: this workspace's credential rows only; the operator workspace (PLATFORM_KEY_WORKSPACE_ID) provably untouched. (5) Endpoint POST /api/workspaces/current/onboarding/reset on the EXISTING workspaces router (no new router file): gated on config.ONBOARDING_RESET_ENABLED (new config.py flag beside the TRIAL_* block ~:1309, default False, documented as TEMPORARY in .env.example) -> 404 when off (not 403 — don't advertise); workspace-admin auth in the same bucket as api/onboarding_agents.py's _require_admin; response returns counts of everything reset/wiped. Update the COMMITTED route manifest (orchestrator/reports/route-manifest.json — hand-add + count bump; test_route_manifest is the CI trap). (6) Frontend dev URL frontend/app/dev/reset-onboarding/page.tsx — unlinked from all nav: shows current stage + trial state (workspace provider), three switches (reset trial / wipe built / wipe credentials), RESET button -> endpoint, then clears tour/onboarding localStorage via the existing frontend/lib/shepherd/tour-storage.ts helpers (IMPORT them — modifying frontend/lib/shepherd/** violates the W2 scope guard), then redirects to chat. Renders a plain 'reset disabled' state on 404. Warns when wipe_credentials is on while reset_trial is off (converted workspace + no key falls through to unmetered platform resolution).
acceptanceCriteria: reset_onboarding exists in onboarding_state.py with the 3 flags; full-doc JSONB reassignment (no in-place mutation); resets counter increments across two consecutive resets; last_reset_at stamped; advance_onboarding_stage's validator diff-identical to main

Reset works from EVERY stage including completed/skipped (terminal) — test parametrized over ALL_STAGES; trial preserved by default; reset_trial yields a fresh active trial at $0 via grant_trial_at_provisioning (call-site grep proves reuse), and a TRIAL_ENABLED=false decline reports a pause in the response without raising

wipe_built reuses workspace_purge internals (import/call-site grep proves it; no duplicated table list) and the survivor test passes: workspace row, users rows, system agents, required_role='onboarding' agents, credentials (when wipe_credentials=False), and the fresh onboarding doc all survive a full-flag reset; a SECOND workspace's rows are untouched (cross-workspace scoping test)
wipe_credentials deletes only this workspace's credential rows; a test proves rows under PLATFORM_KEY_WORKSPACE_ID survive

Endpoint returns 404 when ONBOARDING_RESET_ENABLED is off (test) and 403 for non-admin when on (test); ONBOARDING_RESET_ENABLED read in config.py only (no os.getenv elsewhere); .env.example documents it as temporary
Committed route manifest carries the new route (route-manifest test green); no new router file

frontend/app/dev/reset-onboarding/page.tsx exists, unlinked (no nav/sidebar import references it); component test covers: renders stage+trial, disabled state on 404, and the wipe_credentials-without-reset_trial warning; localStorage cleared via imported tour-storage helpers; frontend/lib/shepherd/** untouched in the diff
